prerequisites.label: myCRMSIM offline documentation set (required for answers)

check.note: Verify: test -f "$HOME/Downloads/openclaw-master-files/mycrmsim/00-INDEX.md" && find "$HOME/Downloads/openclaw-master-files/mycrmsim/articles" -name '*.md' -type f | wc -l  -- expect 156. Declared manual because the PREREQS schema has no path-exists type; install succeeds without it, answering degrades to the shipped deep reference.

prerequisites.satisfy: Place the offline set at $HOME/Downloads/openclaw-master-files/mycrmsim, at docs/ beside SKILL.md, or point $ASMS_DOCS_DIR at it. Re-fetch from https://support.mycrmsim.com if it is missing or holds fewer than 156 articles.

prerequisites.label: python3 (article index and manifest parsing)
prerequisites.satisfy: Install Python 3.9 or newer. On macOS: `xcode-select --install` or `brew install python@3.12`. Verify with `python3 --version`.

prerequisites.label: bash (qc and maintenance scripts)
prerequisites.satisfy: bash ships with macOS at /bin/bash. Verify with `bash --version`. The skill's qc script requires bash 3.2 or newer, which stock macOS provides.

prerequisites.label: myCRMSIM support site (source of truth for re-fetching)

check.note: No credential needed; the support center is public. Browse https://support.mycrmsim.com only when the local set is missing, short of 156 articles, or older than the live site.

prerequisites.satisfy: Use https://support.mycrmsim.com to re-download the article set when the local copy is absent or stale.
